non_cryptographic_notice: NON-CRYPTOGRAPHIC: SplitMix64 is a deterministic 64-bit integer PRNG for reproducible sampling, form assembly, and test generation only. It provides NO cryptographic strength and MUST NEVER be used for security, authentication, tokens, or proctoring.

algorithm.name: SplitMix64
algorithm.reference: Steele, Lea, Flood (2014) SplitMix64 unsigned 64-bit mixing step

seed_constraints.rule: Both Python and JavaScript twins MUST reject any illegal seed identically by throwing/raising E_PRNG_INVALID_SEED before allocating a stream.

js_integer_safety_rule.rule: All PRNG state, step multiplication, bitwise shifts, and rejection-sampling arithmetic in JavaScript MUST use ES BigInt (64-bit masked via & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFn). Floating-point Number arithmetic, Math.random(), Date.now(), 32-bit signed bitwise operators (| 0, >>), and unsafe Number integers (> Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991) are FORBIDDEN inside PRNG computations.
js_integer_safety_rule.json_serialization_rule: 64-bit integer values (u64 draws and seeds > 2^53 - 1) MUST be serialized as exact decimal strings in JSON artifacts because JSON.parse in JavaScript converts unquoted large numbers to IEEE-754 float64 and silently loses low bits.

createStream.description: Validates seed in [1, 2^64 - 1] and initializes deterministic 64-bit state.

nextU64.description: Advances state by gamma mod 2^64 and emits the 64-bit unsigned mixed integer.

nextInt.javascript: stream.nextInt(bound) -> Number (or nextBoundedBigInt for BigInt bounds)
nextInt.bound_constraints: integer bound >= 1 (<= 2^53 - 1 for JS nextInt returning safe Number; <= 2^64 for Python / nextBoundedBigInt); bound <= 0 raises E_PRNG_INVALID_BOUND
nextInt.debiasing_rule: Unbiased 64-bit rejection sampling: threshold = ((1 << 64) - bound) % bound; draw r = nextU64() repeatedly until r >= threshold; return r % bound. Even for bound = 1, consumes one nextU64() draw (threshold = 0) and returns 0.

nextRange.rule: Requires integer bounds with min_inclusive <= max_inclusive; returns min_inclusive + nextInt(max_inclusive - min_inclusive + 1).

shuffle.fisher_yates_rule: Non-mutating top-down Fisher-Yates (Durstenfeld): copy input list/array; for i = n - 1 down to 1: j = nextInt(i + 1); swap arr[i] and arr[j]. When n <= 1, consumes 0 draws and returns a shallow copy.

N24_assembly.purpose: A/B/C form assembly draws, fairness sweeps, and seeded training draws
N24_assembly.recording_rule: Every assembled form manifest MUST record form_seed, policy_id ('splitmix64-u64-v1'), and prng_contract_digest.

N27_sample_selection.purpose: Leitner spaced-selection tie-breaking and deterministic card sampling
N27_sample_selection.recording_rule: Every scheduler selection event MUST record sample_seed and policy_id in the in-memory session log.

N30_workload_generation.purpose: Bounded practice path sampling and ephemeral retry variant parameter draws
N30_workload_generation.recording_rule: Every practice path and ephemeral variant draw MUST record workload_seed, family_id, and policy_id.

N20_bank_authoring.purpose: Deterministic variant authoring for the 112-instance frozen bank
N20_bank_authoring.recording_rule: Every bank variant authoring manifest MUST record numeric prng_seed alongside instance.seed and policy_id.

N05_N36_verification.purpose: Cross-language contract table, property sweeps, and deterministic test sampling
N05_N36_verification.recording_rule: Property and regression test manifests MUST record sweep seeds and policy_id.

replay_rule.formula: recorded_seed + algorithm_id + constants_digest + policy_version + input_list => bit-identical reproducible draw sequence
replay_rule.contract_requirement: Any refactor to tools/prng.py or src/prng.js MUST reproduce all 11 contract seeds × 100 u64 draws, bounded draws, shuffle fixtures, and illegal-seed rejections byte-for-byte.
